sushiTheme.desc:
Bring the finest 'Nigiri' to your coding.
Even when you're bogged down by a nasty bug, just watch the sushi flying across your screen. It's sure to lift your spirits!
Thanks to its lightweight ECS (Entity Component System) design, it won't get in the way of your coding speed!
sushiTheme.effectType.desc: Select the flying sushi effect on typing. (Default: Random)
sushiTheme.particleSpeedMultiplier.desc: Speed multiplier for flying sushi (Default: 1.3. Example: 1.3 is 1.3x speed).
sushiTheme.bounceTopDistance.desc: Distance in pixels the sushi flies upward from the typing cursor before bouncing back (Set to 0 to disable bouncing).
sushiTheme.bounceBottomDistance.desc: Sets the distance to the bottom wall (floor). Set to 0 for no floor (infinite fall). The larger the value, the lower it will bounce.
sushiTheme.bounceLeftDistance.desc: Sets the distance to the left wall. Set to 0 to disable the left wall.
sushiTheme.bounceRightDistance.desc: Sets the distance to the right wall. Set to 0 to disable the right wall.
sushiTheme.feverTriggerCombo.desc: Number of combos to start Fever Time.
sushiTheme.feverDurationMs.desc: How long Fever Time lasts in milliseconds (e.g., 10000 = 10 seconds).
sushiTheme.feverSpawnCount.desc: Number of sushi dropped per keystroke in Fever Time.
sushiTheme.throttleMs.desc: Set the minimum time (in milliseconds) between effect renders. Increase this value (e.g., 100-150) if your editor lags during continuous typing. (Default: 80)
sushiTheme.fps.desc:
Sets the frame rate (draws per second) for effects. Higher values provide smoother animations but increase editor load. 
*Due to VS Code's rendering architecture limitations, the actual frame rate may be capped even if a higher value is set.
sushiTheme.particleLifespanMultiplier.de: Sets the multiplier for the sushi's display time (lifespan). A larger value keeps it on the screen longer, but consumes more memory.
sushiTheme.enableParticleCollision.desc: Enable physics collisions between sushi particles. (Might impact performance if spawning many particles)
sushiTheme.particleRestitution.desc: Bounciness factor when particles collide. 1.0 is perfectly elastic, 0 is inelastic.
